title: Mechanisms do not prove a wage difference
caption: I classify this claim as unsupported. The evidence does not establish that a documented mechanism caused an observed wage difference. The broader evidence can add context or direction, but it cannot erase the strict evidence boundary. The main limit is unsearched, storage-held, conflict, linkage, compatibility, and independent-human-review limits remain. This card states what I can use in the report and what I must not turn into a national or causal conclusion.
